name: @allternit/office
description: Allternit Office Add-ins — Excel, PowerPoint, Word task pane

scripts.predev: npm run manifest:generate && node ./scripts/copy-plugin-skills.mjs && npm run icons:build
scripts.predev:excel: npm run manifest:generate && node ./scripts/copy-plugin-skills.mjs && npm run icons:build
scripts.predev:powerpoint: npm run manifest:generate && node ./scripts/copy-plugin-skills.mjs && npm run icons:build
scripts.predev:word: npm run manifest:generate && node ./scripts/copy-plugin-skills.mjs && npm run icons:build
scripts.prebuild: npm run manifest:generate && node ./scripts/copy-plugin-skills.mjs && npm run icons:build
scripts.prepreview: npm run manifest:generate && node ./scripts/copy-plugin-skills.mjs && npm run icons:build
scripts.dev:excel: concurrently "npm run dev" "office-addin-debugging start manifests/excel.xml --app excel --dev-server-port 3000"
scripts.dev:powerpoint: concurrently "npm run dev" "office-addin-debugging start manifests/powerpoint.xml --app powerpoint --dev-server-port 3000"
scripts.dev:word: concurrently "npm run dev" "office-addin-debugging start manifests/word.xml --app word --dev-server-port 3000"
